bea.notes: Annual 2000/2001 use the December 5, 2024 geographic workbook with its own provenance; the current workbook repeats the 2000 label and omits 2001. Later years use the current release.

comtrade.notes: U.S.-reported customs trade: exports FOB, imports CIF; intentionally not spliced with BEA balance-of-payments series.

iie.notes: Reviewed 2025 PDFs are rechecked daily; new annual report discovery requires manual review. The country-factsheet index was access-restricted during source audit.

macau_tourism.notes: Selected-market PDFs; unlisted U.S. values are missing, never zero. Latest complete annual market profile fills selected-market omissions. Arrivals exclude non-resident workers/students from 2008. Residence classification changed to issuing place of travel document in April 2015; transition is not comparable. This adapter covers complete annual reports, not newer monthly highlights.
macau_tourism.vintage: MGTO annual highlights through 2025; Market Performance 2008, 2010, 2015, 2024

ntto.notes: Workbook modification dates are not official publication dates.

taiwan_tourism.notes: Public open-data CSV; scope differs from NTTO overnight trips.

uis.notes: Taiwan not separately listed; U.S.-to-mainland records may be absent.
